title: Spring Coffee Walk
summary: Bring a thermos and a cup; we walk slowly and taste at the most beautiful spots.
description: A three-hour walk through the spring forest, led by a forester who has been a member for years. We stop at a clearing, a stream and a viewpoint to taste three coffees from thermoses. Wear good shoes; the path is easy but can be muddy.

title: Brew Day on the Hill
summary: Our annual outdoor brewing day in the hilltop meadow under the old oak.
description: Five brewing stations: pour-over, French press, AeroPress, a cold brew bar and a cezve corner. No pressure and no expertise required. Leah leads a blind cupping in the afternoon.

title: Brew Camp
summary: Five days at the lake: sunrise espresso on the jetty, workshops and evening cuppings.
description: Sunrise espresso from lever machines that need no electricity, morning workshops on roasting, latte art and aroma, free afternoons and an evening cupping by the lake. The week ends at the campfire, where everyone gives one word for their week.

title: Cupping Day: The Language of Taste
summary: A monthly cupping about the words we use for flavour, with a poet as guest.
description: Five coffees side by side. Hannah White shows how personal memories can be better tasting notes than "citrus" or "stone fruit". Iris explains what the tongue and nose actually detect.

title: Sea-Salt Coffee With the Harbour Town Group
summary: An online evening with George and the harbour town home brewers.
description: George shows how his group makes sea-salt coffee and runs its "coffee library" for half-used bags. Have a cup, a pinch of salt and your questions ready.

title: Harvest Evening
summary: Celebrating the harvest in origin countries, with producers joining by video.
description: A candlelit evening in the café, decorated with dried coffee cherries from a partner farm. Hope and Ellen join by video from their farms, and we taste their coffees together.

title: Blind Tasting Workshop
summary: Six coffees in numbered cups and no information: trust your own palate.
description: No origin, no roast level, no price, no roaster. You taste, score and choose your favourite; only then do we reveal what was in each cup.

title: Roasters' Circle
summary: The monthly online meeting for small roasters; this month with Erica's micro-roastery.
description: Small roasters share problems and solutions. Erica explains how she runs a roastery in a hill village. We also plan the next pooled green coffee order.

title: Brew Clinic
summary: Free drop-in evening: bring your beans and gear, and we find the one thing to change.
description: You brew in front of a brew host, we taste the result together and find the one change that helps most: grind, ratio or pouring. No question is too basic, and no equipment is too cheap.

title: Autumn Forest Walk
summary: Coffee from a thermos among the autumn leaves.
description: The autumn version of our coffee walk. Cancelled because of a storm warning for the forest; the next walk is in spring.

title: Home Brewers' Forum: My Biggest Coffee Disaster
summary: Short talks about coffee gone wrong, and honest questions from the audience.
description: Peter opens with the wedding cold brew story. Lily, Chris and Samuel tell their own disasters, then the floor is open for questions.

title: Cupping Day: Coffee and Science
summary: Why the same beans taste different: water, grind and agitation, cupped side by side.
description: Iris prepares one coffee five ways and explains each difference in plain words. Bring a notebook if you like; no science background needed.

title: Latte Art Clinic
summary: Pour your first heart, or your first good tulip.
description: Daniel teaches milk steaming and pouring in small groups. Latte art is about ninety per cent in your head; we work on the other ten per cent.

title: Brew Club Season Finale
summary: The last Brew Club of the season: everyone shares one moment from the year.
description: A quiet morning in the community kitchen. We brew, taste and look back on the season from April to November.

title: Night Shift Brewing: Good Coffee in a Thermos
summary: An online session on brewing for long, lonely shifts.
description: Theo, a rail signal technician, shows his hand grinder and thermos routine for night shifts. Rose answers beginners' questions.

title: Christmas Cupping Day at the Old Mill
summary: Candles, pine branches, spiced coffee and five seasonal coffees by the cast-iron stove.
description: Our candlelit December edition at the old mill on the river. Five seasonal coffees, spiced coffee with orange peel and cinnamon, and a final candlelit tasting.
